messages.content: notun creator der jonno first 90 din er ekta realistic roadmap dite paro bistarito?

Obviously প্রতিটা niche আলাদা, kintu general structure ta ami share korte pari. First 30 din: consistency establish kora shobcheye important, quality niye eto worry na kore posting rhythm build kora - daily na parle, ekta fixed weekly schedule thik kore sheta strictly follow kora। Ei phase e engagement kom thakবেই, eta normal, discourage howar dorkar nai. Next 30 din (31-60): audience feedback dekhe adjust kora shuru kora - kon content type beshi response pacche, kon time e post korle better reach hocche, eishob pattern notice kora। Personally amar mote ei phase tai shobcheye important, karon ekhane creator der beshi mane experiment kore data er base e, guess kore na. Last 30 din (61-90): ekta clearer content identity establish howa uchit - ekta specific angle ba style ja audience associate korte pare tomar sathe. Ei somoy e first monetization step gulo o start kora jete pare jodi audience base thik thake, jemon tip jar/small subscription tier। Sotti bolte, 90 din e clear success dekha jabe emon guarantee kew dite parbe na, kintu ei structure follow korle at least ekta clear, measurable progress dekha jabe, random effort er cheye onek better.
